writing_style: Clear everyday written Tibetan; exact local variety to be agreed with the first reviewers.

first_task.description: Read a short nonclinical everyday passage and return the exact requested source span, or the declared no-answer label when the passage does not supply the answer.
first_task.review_criteria: Independent native reviewers check whether the answer addresses the question, is supported by the passage, preserves numbers and negation, and correctly declines absent information. Confirm the no-answer label and local writing variety before preregistration.

critical_failure_categories.definition: A number, time, date, quantity or unit differs from the passage.
The answer reverses or drops a negation that changes the passage meaning.
The answer supplies information not supported by the passage.
The answer invents a response when the requested information is absent.
